---
title: "All of Statistics — Solutions"
---

My solutions to the exercises in Larry Wasserman's
*All of Statistics: A Concise Course in Statistical Inference*, updated on a rolling basis as I work through the book.

This approach is designed to help me refer back to the material for many years, so the solutions are likely more verbose than necessary, with definitions, lemmas, syntax explicitly re-stated.

## How this site is organized

- Each chapter is a single `.qmd` file (e.g. `chapter02.qmd`).
- The [chapter template](template.qmd) shows the formatting conventions
  (math, proofs, code, figures) — copy/paste from it when starting a new
  problem or chapter.

::: {.callout-note}
Solutions are my own attempts and may contain errors. Corrections welcome via
the repo.
:::
